Qatar
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Doha, Qatar.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
From December 12, 2019, Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are allowed to obtain a free tourist visa for a period of up to 30 days upon entering the country with the possibility of free extension for an additional 30 days, provided that they are in possession of a passport valid for at least three months, a confirmed return flight ticket, a confirmed hotel reservation at any hotel in Qatar during the period of visit, or a document of the exact address of stay, and health insurance from an accredited insurance company in Qatar:https://www.moph.gov.qa/arabic/departments/ministeroffice/hfid/hirs/insurancecompanies/Pages/default.aspxCitizens of the State of Qatar are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for a period of up to 90 days in a period of six months, starting from the date of first entry.
